# Mobile client

## Goal
A small mobile client for Acme customers to browse the catalogue and place orders. It talks to the existing Acme API and never stores payment details.

## State
Idea raised by the CEO on 2026-11-17. Feasibility discussed in chat: the API already covers catalogue and orders. Requirements stated by the CEO and all open questions answered on 2026-11-17: an iOS app named Acme, repo `example-owner/acme-app` (private first), English UI.

## Next step
The CoS records the decision, opens issues for the changes the requirements need, and briefs the engineering spike.
